shellCommands.command: grep -rn "PROXY_FILENAME\|MIDDLEWARE_FILENAME\|'proxy'" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== deprecation ==="; grep -rn "middleware.*deprecat\|deprecat.*middleware" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -5

grep -rn "proxy" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack/loaders/next-middleware-loader.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== entry handling ==="; grep -rn "default\b.*proxy\|proxy.*default" node_modules/next/dist/build/entries.js 2>/dev/null | head -10

grep -rn "PROXY_FILENAME\|proxy" node_modules/next/dist/build/utils.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "export\|default\|handler" | head -10; echo "=== types ==="; ls node_modules/next/dist/types/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "ProxyConfig\|export.*proxy" node_modules/next/types/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

grep -rn "NextRequest\|NextResponse\|ProxyConfig\|MiddlewareConfig" node_modules/next/server.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== server.js exports ==="; node -e "const s=require('/workspace/node_modules/next/server.js'); console.log(Object.keys(s).join(', '))" 2>&1 | head -5

sed -n '1,40p' node_modules/next/server.d.ts; echo "=== ProxyConfig def ==="; grep -rn "ProxyConfig" node_modules/next/dist/build/segment-config/proxy/proxy-config.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/next/dist -name "proxy-config.d.ts" 2>/dev/null | head

curl -s -o /dev/null -w "page: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3000/nope?a=1" ; sleep 3; echo "=== dev log ==="; grep -n "\[request\]" /tmp/dev.log | head -30

CHUNK=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE '/_next/static/[^"]+\.js' | head -1); echo "chunk: $CHUNK"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "chunk: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3000$CHUNK"; sleep 2; echo "=== requests logged ==="; grep "\[request\]" /tmp/dev.log | tail -10
pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; timeout 180 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -25
